headline: Bruno Fernandes will start
body: Sports Mole preview (Ben Knapton), updated 30 Oct 2026: Fernandes should return to the Man Utd XI at Chelsea; Carrick said he remains fully committed after clear-the-air talks. Predicted XI includes Fernandes behind Cunha. Mainoo back in training; Shaw, Šeško, Ugarte, Dorgu still missing.
